points.description: States that there is no atmosphere (no air / a vacuum) on the Moon, so sound cannot travel there. Accept equivalent wording, e.g. 'चंद्रावर हवा नाही' or 'चंद्रावर निर्वात आहे'; the idea that sound needs a material medium (air) to travel may be added but is not required.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the Moon has no atmosphere/air (a vacuum), which is why sound cannot travel between the astronauts. A response that only says sound needs a medium without stating that the Moon lacks one earns no marks, as does an unrelated answer. No part marks are given for this one-mark question.
